patterns: APPSC repeats the Ruskin 'Unto This Last' -> 'Sarvodaya' translation with Tolstoy/Thoreau/Carlyle distractors.
Persons->plan items: Sarvodaya Plan 1950 = Jayaprakash Narayan; Bhoodan began at Pochampalli (1951).
Meaning items: Sarvodaya = welfare of all; 'good of individual contained in good of all' as Ruskin's message.
AP angle: Ponduru khadi, Prakasam's Guravareddypalem centre, Samagra Gramseva key.
App adds philosophical roots (Bondaref, Gita yajna, law of trusts) slightly deeper than PYQs.
